story-context.title: AU Baseline Analysis And Iterative Prompt Improvement Loop
story-context.overview: Run the BMAD Analyst-owned AU prompt improvement loop against the frozen Story 6.4.6 AU baseline. The Analyst reviews baseline evidence, proposes the top five prompt/context improvements, waits for Tony approval, executes one controlled experiment, ingests judges, updates AU-001, and stops for the keep/reject/revise/continue decision.

critical-objectives.item: Review AU-000 baseline evidence before proposing prompt/context changes.
Present top five candidate improvements with target section, expected movement, risk, and bundleability.
Wait for Tony approval before editing prompt/context artifacts or running a candidate experiment.
Execute exactly one controlled change set through the Analyst experiment harness.
Ingest Claude, Grok, and GPT-5 mini judge outputs and compare against the frozen baseline.
Update STORY-6-AU-EVAL-ITERATION-TRACKING.md with AU-001 and stop for Tony decision.

Complete; locale registry and rubric_v2 foundation exists.
dependencies.doc: Analyst execution contract; file name retained for Epic 6 workflow compatibility.
Tracking sheet with AU-000 baseline and future AU-001 row.
Manual Cursor judge workflow and ingest instructions.

constraints.item: Do NOT modify application, backend, frontend, harness, judge-ingest, or migration code.
Do NOT overwrite the frozen baseline folder: _bmad-output/eval-runs/story-6.4.6-au-baseline-current/.
Do NOT run a candidate experiment before Tony approves the selected controlled change set.
Do NOT bundle unrelated changes for speed.
Do NOT proceed to a second loop without Tony approval.
Use PowerShell-safe commands; no ampersand command chaining.
Tony must run/save manual Cursor judge outputs when model sessions are required.

path.note: Persistent loop rules and hard constraints.
AU-000 baseline row exists; Analyst adds AU-001.
Baseline diagnostic summary, judge findings, deterministic failures.
AU benchmark prompt set for candidate runs.
Analyst experiment runner; use as-is unless a Dev fix story is raised.
Judge output ingest; use as-is unless a Dev fix story is raised.
